firm_data.firm_description: Stanley Law Offices is a Legal Services company providing legal representation to clients in New York and Pennsylvania. The firm specializes in personal injury law, workers' compensation, and social security disability benefits.
notable_facts: Has six office locations throughout Upstate NY and PA
Uses the 'Stanley System' to maximize awards for clients
Joe Stanley hosts a weekly radio show answering legal questions

email.subject: AI for Stanley Law Offices, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Joe,

Stanley Law Offices has spent 37 years building trust in personal injury and workers' compensation across New York and Pennsylvania. That foundation matters, especially as case complexity grows and client expectations shift.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in upstate NY to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
